description_excerpt: Job Description • Provide L2 application support and contribute to L3 issue resolution for SAP FI processes and related integrations. • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents, service requests, and problem tickets within agreed SLAs. • Support business users across key SAP FI areas, including: • General Ledger (GL) • Accounts Payable (AP) • Accounts Receivable (AR) • Asset Accounting (AA) • Bank Accounting • Tax and Financial Closing • Perform root cause analysis and propose sustainable solutions for recurring issues. • Collaborate with cross-functional SAP teams, including CO, MM, SD,…
